newsitem.title: UK: UK'S J. SAVILLE GORDON ACQUIRES PROPERTY.
newsitem.headline: UK'S J. SAVILLE GORDON ACQUIRES PROPERTY.

text.p: Britain's J. Saville Gordon Group Plc said on Wednesday it had purchased an industrial portfolio from Park Street Ltd for 6.86 million stg.
The property's total area is 171,000 square feet and has been bought through acquiring the enter issued share capital of Park Street for 2.13 million stg.
In addition, JSG has assumed a 20-year fixed rate loan of 4.54 million stg bearing an interest of 9.05 percent.
The portfolio comprises three industrial estates in Watford, Croydon in southern England and Morley, Yorkshire in north east England, producing current rental income of 844,000 stg.
